jobs.title: Senior AI Presales Specialist
jobs.why: Strong AI workflow and client-facing background, accepting equivalent experience for degree. (capped: 3 verified requirement gaps)

hard_skills.note: Demonstrates LLM architecture, PoC development, and technical workflows.

experience.note: Combines 6+ years commercial/sales with hands-on AI product building.

education.note: Accepts equivalent professional experience in lieu of degree.

blockers: Lack of Enterprise AI Presales and RFP Experience
Insufficient Years of Experience in Technology or Solution Engineering

jd.text:
We are looking for a Senior AI Presales Specialist to support our commercial and business development activities across AI-related opportunities.

The role will work closely with clients, sales, business development, and AI technical teams to understand business challenges, identify AI use cases, develop high-level solution concepts, and lead technical presales activities across proposals, RFPs, presentations, demonstrations, and Proofs of Concept (PoCs).

The ideal candidate will bring strong AI technical expertise, solution consulting, and client-facing experience, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical and compelling AI solutions.

Requirements

Lead client discovery sessions, workshops, and technical discussions to understand business and technical requirements.
Identify and assess AI use cases and opportunities that can deliver measurable business value.
Translate client requirements into high-level AI solution concepts and technical approaches.
Lead technical presales activities across AI opportunities.
Work closely with sales and business development teams to shape and qualify AI opportunities.
Lead the technical contribution to RFPs, tenders, proposals, and bids.
Develop solution descriptions, technical approaches, assumptions, dependencies, and high-level implementation concepts.
Prepare and deliver compelling AI presentations and solution demonstrations to technical and executive stakeholders.
Lead or support AI Proof-of-Concept (PoC) activities during the presales cycle.
Develop conceptual solution architectures, workflows, and technical diagrams.
Evaluate and recommend relevant AI technologies, platforms, integrations, and approaches.
Collaborate with AI architects, engineers, enterprise architects, cybersecurity, and delivery teams to validate proposed solutions.
Communicate technical concepts, capabilities, limitations, risks, and dependencies clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
Support technical clarification meetings and client negotiations when required.
Stay current with emerging AI technologies, market trends, and enterprise AI use cases.
Develop reusable AI demonstrations, solution assets, technical content, and presales materials.
Mentor and provide guidance to junior team members where required.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
4+ years of professional experience in technology, consulting, solution engineering, presales, or a related field.
Strong experience in AI Presales, AI Consulting, Solution Consulting, Solution Architecture, or Technical Presales.
Proven experience engaging directly with enterprise or government clients.
Strong experience translating business requirements into technical solutions.
Experience leading or contributing to complex technology sales opportunities.
Strong experience with technical proposals, RFPs, tenders, and bid responses.
Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and executive-level stakeholders.

Technical Knowledge

Strong practical knowledge of several of the following areas:

Generative AI
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
AI Agents
Machine Learning
Natural Language Processing (NLP)
Document Intelligence
Vector Databases
AI APIs
Cloud AI Platforms
Enterprise Integration
Data Platforms
Prompt Engineering
AI Security and Governance
Solution Architecture

Hands-on AI development experience is beneficial, but the primary focus of the role is AI solutioning, presales, client engagement, and technical consulting.

Preferred Experience

Experience leading AI presales engagements for enterprise or government clients.
Experience designing and presenting AI solutions to senior stakeholders.
Experience leading AI demonstrations and PoCs.
Experience with complex RFPs, tenders, and enterprise technology proposals.
Experience working within IT consulting or technology services organisations.
Familiarity with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data platforms, and cloud environments.
Experience mentoring junior presales or technical team members.

Key Skills

AI Presales
Solution Consulting
AI Solutioning
Client Engagement
Requirements Gathering
Technical Presentations
RFP & Tender Management
Solution Architecture
AI Technologies
Stakeholder Management
Business & Commercial Awareness
Technical Documentation
Problem Solving
Communication & Negotiation

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a senior professional who can understand complex client challenges, identify where AI can create value, and translate those challenges into credible and compelling AI solutions.

The successful candidate should be comfortable leading client discussions, presenting to senior stakeholders, supporting complex sales opportunities, and working closely with technical teams to shape solutions from initial discovery through the presales stage.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Storefront
jobs.why: Strong founder/AI/search alignment, but candidate targets IC engineering rather than PM. (capped: 1 verified requirement gap)

hard_skills.note: Proven 0-to-1 Arabic search/discovery and AI prototyping experience.

experience.note: Product experience is solo founder rather than 4-6y dedicated PM.

blockers: Lacks 4–6 Years of Dedicated Product Management Experience

jd.text:
At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, empowering thousands of merchants to start, grow, and scale their businesses. We turn what's complex into something simple, powerful, and scalable.
Every Salla store runs on one storefront. When a buyer searches, opens a product, or reads a review, they decide whether to trust a store they may have never heard of. Every change you ship reaches thousands of stores at once.
We are looking for a Product Manager who builds with curiosity, clarity, and care. You own search, the product page, and reviews: how buyers find what they want, decide, and trust what they read. You work side by side with our data and AI teams and turn their models into decisions buyers feel and merchants see in their sales.
Core Responsibilities:
Know Salla's buyers: how they shop across very different stores, and what makes them hesitate, compare, or leave. Bring their voice into every decision, along with the merchants whose sales depend on it.
Own search, the product page, and reviews end to end, from discovery to iteration, tied to buyer conversion and merchant sales.
Partner with data and AI teams on ranking, query understanding, and semantic search. Decide what ships, to which stores, and how you measure it.
Design the product page around the buyer's decision: what they need to see, trust, and confirm before they buy.
Build reviews that buyers trust and merchants can use, including for stores with few or no reviews.
Experiment by default and Ship safely across thousands of stores: staged rollouts, experiments, guardrails, and a way back.
Run continuous discovery: talk to buyers and merchants regularly, watch real sessions, and test ideas with prototypes before committing engineering time.
Make decisions with data: define the metrics that matter for each surface, read the funnel yourself, and let evidence, not opinion, settle debates.
Requirements
4–6 years of experience in Product Management , preferably owning Search, Discovery, Product Pages, Conversion, or other customer-facing product experiences within a live consumer or e-commerce product.
Proven experience driving product metrics and business outcomes , with the ability to explain what changed, why it changed, and how the impact was measured.
AI-native mindset with hands-on experience using AI tools for data analysis, prototyping, research and interpreting product results.
Experience working closely with Data Science and Machine Learning teams on Search, Ranking, or Recommendation with a clear understanding of product ownership and decision-making responsibilities.
Hands-on experience conducting User Research and Product Experiments, using insights to influence product decisions.
Strong understanding of Arabic Search and Discovery , including Arabic spelling variations, dialects, transliteration, Arabic-English mixed queries, and search behavior.
Demonstrated ownership of product outcomes , with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and move quickly in a fast-paced environment.
You simplify: you cut before you add.
Fluent in Arabic and English , both written and spoken.
Preferred: Experience building a product, feature, or business from 0-to-1 , either as a founder, early-stage team member, or founding product team member.

jobs.title: Commercial Solutions Engineer, KSA
jobs.why: Relevant commercial and tech background, but lacks required 3-5+ years in B2B SaaS pre-sales.

hard_skills.note: Has tech and data skills, lacks dedicated enterprise SaaS SE tooling.

experience.note: Strong commercial sales and AI engineering, but lacks B2B pre-sales tenure.

education.note: Accepts equivalent practical experience despite diploma.

seniority_location.note: Based in Riyadh, bilingual Arabic/English matches perfectly.

blockers: Lack of B2B SaaS Pre-Sales or Senior Construction Management Experience

jd.text:
We’re looking for a Commercial Solutions Engineer to join Procore’s Pre-Sales Solutions Engineering team. In this role, you’ll serve as a technical subject matter expert and champion throughout the acquisition sales cycle across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). Your primary goal will be to partner with regional sales teams and construction leaders to articulate Procore’s overall value proposition and drive platform adoption.

As a Commercial Solutions Engineer, you’ll partner with Account Executives, Product Specialists, and Customer Success teams to deliver value-based technical demonstrations and address prospects' complex business challenges. Use your deep technical aptitude, construction industry knowledge, and consultative presentation skills to demonstrate the ROI of digitizing project management processes. Join us to be a key catalyst in modernizing KSA's rapidly growing construction ecosystem

This position reports into the Director of Solutions Engineering and will be based in our Riyadh office (with initial EOR arrangement). We’re looking for someone to join us immediately. 


What you’ll do:
Own pre-sales technical support for prospects and partners across KSA from initial contact through product demonstration and close.
Craft value-based product demonstrations and technical presentations that directly address local customer business challenges and accelerate Procore platform adoption.
Partner closely with the regional Account Executive team to close new business by resolving prospects' technical, integration, and process hurdles.
Act as a trusted customer advocate, helping Saudi construction organizations adopt international best practices around digital project management.
Coordinate internal and external technical resources to support complex sales cycles and RFP technical responses.
Enable and train new regional Account Executives to transform them into Procore product experts.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to connect local market feedback directly with Procore's product roadmap.

What we’re looking for: 
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
3–5+ years of experience in Sales Engineering/Pre-Sales within B2B SaaS, OR senior operational experience within the regional construction industry (e.g., BIM Manager, Digital Transformation Director, Projects Director, Contracts Manager).
Fluency in both Arabic and English is required, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to master complex software platforms, construction workflows, and emerging industry technologies.
Proven track record of delivering engaging, value-oriented product presentations to executives, project managers, and technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical, consultative, and problem-solving skills to translate customer pain points into clear technical solutions.
Collaborative mindset with a proven ability to work cross-functionally under tight go-to-market timelines.
Passion for acting as a technology evangelist and driving digital transformation across the Middle East construction sector.

hard_skills.note: Matches React, TypeScript, Python, SQL, REST APIs, and CI/CD.

jd.text:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will work with clients across a wide range of sectors and industries, advising them on how to best leverage technology.

You will drive architectural design, make key technology decisions, and employ agile methodologies to build and deliver the next generation of products for our clients at scale.

You will also lead project workstreams, helping clients build their technical capabilities and foster a culture centered around engineering best practices, user-centricity, and Agile values.

As a core member of the team, you will take on responsibilities that include driving architectural design and making strategic technology decisions to shape next-generation products for various internal teams, ensuring that we remain at the forefront of technological innovation.

Additionally, you will be hands-on and co-creating solutions alongside our clients and their leadership, enabling you to grow into a recognized technology leader.

You will be part of the Tech & AI at McKinsey team in Riyadh/Doha or Dubai. This group brings together the best of McKinsey’s digital capabilities to help our clients use digital technology to transform their businesses.

Tech & AI at McKinsey is our tech delivery people unit. A global team of software, data and cloud engineers, passionate designers, technology architects, product owners, and leading technologists.

You will join a multidisciplinary community of developers, Agile coaches, designers, business strategists and experts. Together, we will design and create industry shaping products and tools for our clients.

Our office culture is casual and social, with an emphasis on education and innovation. You will have the freedom to try new ideas and experiment in your role and will be guaranteed significant dedicated time to tinker, create, continuously learn and share cool new stuff. We also have a strong emphasis in our teams on mentoring others enabling them to grow and learn.

Changing the world requires us to sit with our clients at times, so some travel is expected in this role.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Undergraduate or master’s degree; or equivalent experience
7+ years of experience in software development, with significant full-stack web application development experience strongly preferred
Demonstrated knowledge and hands-on experience across the full application stack with some of the following languages/frameworks: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, Vue, jQuery, Java, Sprint, C#, .NET, Node.js, SQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, cloud-native databases, AWS, Azure, GCP, Jenkins, Docker, Circle CI, Travis
Experience leading in Agile teams, including coaching and modeling Agile mindsets as part of sprint ceremonies, work definition and building developer capabilities
Experience working collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members and stakeholders including modeling and coaching others to use engineering best practices such as design patterns, customer-centric design, test-driven development, code refactoring, code review, and OWASP Top 10 security awareness
